payload.value: Filesystem blob bytes driver is implemented and done. It stores blob bytes under FRICK_BLOB_STORAGE_PATH when FRICK_BLOB_DRIVER=filesystem, keeps metadata in SQLite, validates the path at startup, writes atomically, and enforces tenant isolation through the store facade. See apps/server/src/storage/blob-bytes-driver.ts, apps/server/tests/blob-bytes-driver.test.ts, and docs/operations.md.
